description: React component for creating and managing tests, including creating new tests, listing existing tests, and performing actions like submit and evaluate.

methods.name: loadTests
methods.description: Fetches list of tests from API and updates state.

methods.name: addQuestion
methods.description: Adds a new question of specified type (multiple-choice or short-answer) to the questions list.

methods.name: updateQuestionText
methods.description: Updates the text of a specific question.

methods.name: updateChoice
methods.description: Updates a specific choice in a multiple-choice question.

methods.name: addChoice
methods.description: Adds a new choice to a multiple-choice question.

methods.name: setCorrectIndex
methods.description: Sets the correct answer index for a multiple-choice question.

methods.name: setShortAnswer
methods.description: Sets the answer for a short-answer question.

methods.name: resetForm
methods.description: Resets the form fields to initial state.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates a new test by sending data to API, then resets form and reloads tests.

methods.name: onSubmitStub
methods.description: Placeholder function to submit responses for a test.

methods.name: onEvaluate
methods.description: Triggers evaluation of a test via API.
